message: A good player should almost always clear the tier-1 sector (run waves 1-5)
An average player should usually clear the tier-1 sector
A good player should clear tier 4 (the demo cutoff, run wave 20) at least half the time
A no-upgrade bad player should die inside the demo half of the campaign
Tiers 3-4 should push a good player below 60% HP somewhere
Median wave clear should stay between 15s and 120s
